# Agent integration patches

Upstream base: `v0.6.0`, `fa29a30ad25e362acc349bea6ce4b025bdd8be5a`.
Six rows came over from the earlier integration: #458 to #463. The other eleven behaviour rows restore behaviour the earlier integration had and the tag drops: #465 to #472 and #476 to #478; #465 was an unlisted change of that integration. Each of the seventeen behaviour changes has an upstream issue asking for the same contract; the last row is wording only.

Four further rows keep the Agent's own request on the OpenAI Chat protocol: the capability classifier's export, which the compatible protocol reads to apply the same reasoning-model rules; `top_k`, which the Agent sent and a compatible endpoint reads; any explicitly selected `serviceTier`; and the assistant `reasoning_content` a thinking model behind an OpenAI-shaped endpoint requires on later turns. They carry no issue number: the classifier export is an upstream feature request, the reasoning replay has an upstream bug report, and the other two keep request fields the tag warns about.

The replay has an upstream bug report. | `dim-agent-aimux/src/request/tests.rs`: `final_request_replays_multimodal_tool_history_and_only_model_readable_results` requires `reasoning_content` in the `openai-chat` assistant message; `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow/native.rs`: `openai_chat_protocols_send_reasoning_models_the_rules_they_accept` requires it on a gpt-5 tool turn. |

The workspace member list is reduced to the four crates the Agent uses; production source is retained verbatim except for the changes above.

The Agent turns on `CallOptions.strict_stream` for every call, so the tag's strict stream owns the block lifecycle. The checks the integration keeps are these six: a block still open at `Finish`; a completed tool call that repeats, or whose name differs from its `ToolInputStart`; an unsupported warning fails the call; provider-executed tools and provider-generated files, sources and tool results are refused; a content-filtered, errored or other finish fails the turn; and tool input must parse as a JSON object.

The vendored tree carries the tag's own crates, test modules and the fixtures those modules include. The three regression test files the integration used to add were removed with the upgrade; the assertions the tag still satisfies are pinned in `crates/dim-agent-aimux/tests/vendor_contract.rs` and the existing model-flow suites, and the ones it no longer satisfies are listed as behaviour differences. Where a patch changes behaviour a tag test pins, that test's expectation follows the patch.

The patches do not add timeouts, retries, repair, or new model configuration fields, and nothing here enables Core orchestration or host-side tool-call repair in the Agent.
